# Weaviate MCP

Ask natural-language questions and run AI-powered searches over your Weaviate Cloud collections through the provider-hosted Query Agent MCP server.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/weaviate-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Query agent ask** (read-only): Ask Mode transforms your query into actionable searches or aggregations, and then provides a final answer to the question.
- **Query agent search** (read-only): Search Mode combines AI-powered semantic search with structured filtering and returns the matching Weaviate objects directly.
